title: PCA in Cooking
body:
Minoli is using PCA to find two-dimensional representations of cooking show contestants. She collected the following dataset, $$	ext{cooks}, $$ where each row describes a contestant. $$	ext{cooks}$$ has the following columns:
• $$	ext{license\_grade}:$$ The contestant's culinary license grade, between $$1$$ and $$3$$ inclusive.
• $$	ext{num\_stores}:$$ Number of restaurants the contestant owns.
• $$	ext{avg\_ratings}:$$ Contestant's online rating, between $$-5$$ and $$5$$ inclusive.
• $$	ext{num\_points}:$$ Total number of points the contestant won in the show, between $$0$$ and $$5$$ inclusive.
